The user wants the price of a business class flight from Rivermist to Los Angeles on December 15th, 2026. We need to get the nearest airport to Rivermist. Then get flight cost. So we need to call get_nearest_airport_by_city with location "Rivermist". Then call get_flight_cost with travel_from (airport code), travel_to "LAX" (Los Angeles). Actually the location "Los Angeles" is a city; we need the nearest airport to Los Angeles. But we can use "Los Angeles" as location. The function get_nearest_airport_by_city expects location from enum list. "Los Angeles" is in the list. So we need to call get_nearest_airport_by_city twice: one for Rivermist, one for Los Angeles. Then call get_flight_cost with travel_from, travel_to, travel_date "2026-12-15", travel_class "business". Then output the cost.

We need to do two calls to get_nearest_airport_by_city. Let's do first for Rivermist. Then second for Los Angeles. Then get_flight_cost. We'll need to chain calls. We'll do first call.
